about_the_game:
MR. FLESH FLAM is a single-player psychological horror game with elements of combat and fast paced gameplay.

The game follows Albert Aretz. Albert enjoys creating YouTube videos and skating. However, he doesn't realize someone is watching every move he does. Every second of every video is seen by this entity.

This entity lives in permanent limbo, and is deeply connected spiritually to Albert. He is the embodiment of Albert's creativity and the deep problems that associate with said creativity.

This entity is deeply interested in any little persona Albert creates.

Will these decisions and imaginative choices come back to bite Albert? If so, how will they?

All of this is and will be answered in MR. FLESH FLAM.

MR. FLESH FLAM's gameplay is primarily based around stealth, and strategy. The game forces the player to think quick during intense situations. And at other points of the game, you may be forced to search an area carefully whilst avoiding a threat. The gameplay may also include sections where the player can choose to fight back, which adds an extra element of control and combat to the game.

MR. FLESH FLAM's overarching story is split up into episodes that will release overtime. Of course, this is very common nowadays. So, my way of making it easier on the player is once you own the game, you are promised these things.

  • Every future episode of the game for free

  • Updates to previous episodes that may need polishing, bug fixes, extra voice acting, etc.

Both of these promises will be met with no extra cost, you buy the game once, and you will be able to see the whole story unfold over time. No DLC will be needed to complete the game.

These episodes are split into chapters, so if you close the game, you can go back the section, or 'chapter' you left off on.

On the topic of DLC, there may be paid DLC in the future that adds other game-modes that aren't needed for an average playthrough, like a multiplayer mode.

The additional, quality of life features of MR. FLESH FLAM are listed below.

  • A lot of achievements that encourage replaying certain episodes.

  • Secrets or easter eggs

  • Voice Acting

  • An Original Soundtrack

  • Captions

These features and more create an immersive playing experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GForce GTX 1050
  • Additional Notes: You can probably run this on whatever you're using. Any Windows version will work. Probably.

short_description: MR FLESH FLAM is a single-player psychological horror game. When a mysterious person stuck in the line between reality and mentality gets lonely, he creates his own friends out of flesh and needles.
